messages:
Maria Alvarez: Quick plan for the Starlight launch newsletter + webinar handoff. High level: welcome drip for new signups, 3-email webinar invite series, and a 2-week nurture for engaged leads. :rocket:
Ajay Patel: Nice — what's the canary cohort size and segmentation? also we need send windows by region.
Maria Alvarez: Canary = 5% of active trial users (last 30d). Full = master list + re-engaged cold leads. Regional send windows: US midday (~13:00 PT), EU morning (~10:00 CET), APAC evening (~18:00 SGT). Cadence: Day0 invite, Day3 reminder, Day7 last push, Day14 follow-up with recording. :email:
Sophie Chen: Subject line ideas to A/B: (A) "Starlight: Faster LLM inference — live demo" (B) "Cut inference cost 2x — see Starlight in action". Preheader: "Live demo + benchmark highlights + Q&A".
Sophie Chen: Quick copy draft for invite hero: "Join us to see real-world latency and cost wins with Starlight — demo, benchmarks, and live Q&A." CTA: Register now.
Maria Alvarez: Adding UTMs — use this pattern for all campaign links so analytics can group easily:
```
?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=starlight_launch&utm_content={variant}
```
Ajay Patel: Good. Also propose we run subject-line A/B on the canary (50/50) then pick winner for full. Metrics: opens -> choose winner, but cap based on statistical significance or wait 6 hours.
Kai Reynolds: Ops note — we need inbound lead routing for webinar signups. Endpoint: `POST https://hooks.redwood.com/marketing/leads` with payload (minimal): `{"email":"...","utm_campaign":"starlight_launch","source":"newsletter"}`. Please tag leads as `starlight_webinar` and route to AE queue `launch_inbound`. Who can set the webhook + routing rule?
Samir Bhatt: I can set the cohort tags in analytics and add a dashboard. Suggest we target CTR lift from baseline 4% -> goal 6% for the canary. Also let's capture `engagement_score` for follow-ups so SDRs prioritize.
Ajay Patel: Timeline check — canary send Tue 09:00 PT next week, decision window 6 hours after send, full rollout Wed 09:00 PT if winner clear. Sophie — can design deliver 3 hero variants by EOD Fri?
Sophie Chen: Yes. I'll upload hero variants to /design/starlight/hero-variants and share links. Will also export 600px and 1200px sizes.
Maria Alvarez: Great. Samir — can you create the tracking dashboard and a small QA cohort of 2k users for subject/headline sanity checks?
Samir Bhatt: On it. I'll create `starlight_canary_2k` cohort and a dashboard with opens, clicks, reg conversions. Will set alert if CTR < 2% or bounce rate > 1.5%.
Kai Reynolds: I'll open a ticket with Eng to wire the webhook and create the routing rule. Ticket: MGMT-4872. ETA EOD Monday.
launchbot: Campaign scheduled: `starlight_launch` — canary: 1759180000, full rollout: 1759200000. Reminder set for operations channel.
Maria Alvarez: Thanks all — I'll update the campaign doc (shared drive) with this plan and the calendar. Ping here for any blockers. :white_check_mark:
